# What version 3.0 did about the audit

Emitted from `tools/audit_register.py`, so it cannot drift from the register the audit page shows.

v3.0 answered the audit directly, in §30.18. Of 116 items, **26 are fixed in the design document itself**, 23 moved without being resolved, and 38 are new. Six came from reading v3.0 the way v2.3 was read. The rest came from building the harnesses §19.27 now depends on, and from writing all 48 laws out against the rule sheet §7.3 claims they change.

## The shape of it

§30.18 draws the right conclusion from the v2.3 audit: *"a table that exists only to summarise something else should be generated, never authored — four of the six conflicts had no other cause."*

v3.0 then fixed six systems and left a stale copy of four of them. `tools/check_design_consistency.py` has a **Supersession** section that names each one and the exact sentence still carrying the old version; it fails until they are gone. The sharpest case is §29.1, the formulas appendix: it still tabulates the detection model §12.8 deleted, and cites §12.8 as its source.

This file is generated for that reason.
